description: STEP 3 (Streaming): Real-time streaming token detokenizer for LLM Server-Sent Events (SSE) and stdio chunk pipelines. Buffers split token candidates across chunk boundaries (e.g. '[EM' + 'AIL_1]') so no characters or tokens are corrupted. Pass 'flush: true' on the final chunk.

chunk.description: The incoming text chunk from the LLM stream or stdout.

flush.description: Optional. Set to true on the final chunk or at EOF to flush remaining buffer. Defaults to false.

reset.description: Optional. Set to true to reset internal streaming buffer for this session. Defaults to false.

session_id.description: Optional session ID matching the sanitize_text call for multi-agent isolation. Defaults to 'default'.

name: stream_reveal_text
